# Random Unlock

A mod that starts all items as locked, and then randomly unlocks one item whenever you touch a unique item, to freshen up the gameplay experience.

## Wiki

Check out the [wiki](https://github.com/magnushjensen/random-unlock/wiki) for detailed documentation.

If you think anything is missing from the wiki that is unclear, send a message in the discord or open an [improve documentation issue](https://github.com/MagnusHJensen/random-unlock/issues/new?template=3.Improve_docs.md).
